run_job: run the cache maintenance job with action configured via environment variables
backfill_all_datasets: backfill all datasets with HuggingFace endpoint, token, blocked datasets, and storage clients
backfill_retryable_errors: backfill datasets that had retryable errors with HuggingFace endpoint, token, and storage clients
collect_cache_metrics: collect cache metrics from the MongoDB cache database
collect_queue_metrics: collect queue metrics and worker size job counts from the MongoDB queue database
